steps.label: System Info
steps.desc: Shows Windows version, RAM, disk usage and security status

steps.label: Wallpaper M-Auto
steps.cmd: $d=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'M-Auto'; New-Item $d -ItemType Directory -Force -EA SilentlyContinue|Out-Null; $w=Join-Path $d 'wallpaper.png'; Write-Output 'Downloading wallpaper...'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=[Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; (New-Object Net.WebClient).DownloadFile('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mclaudiopt/m-auto.online/main/IMG/mauto/m-auto-rust.png',$w); $sz=[math]::Round((Get-Item $w).Length/1KB); Write-Output "Downloaded: ${sz}KB"; Write-Output 'Applying wallpaper...'; Add-Type -TypeDefinition 'using System;using System.Runtime.InteropServices;public class WPS{[DllImport("user32.dll",CharSet=CharSet.Auto)]static extern int SystemParametersInfo(int a,int b,string c,int d);public static void Set(string p){SystemParametersInfo(20,0,p,3);}}' -EA SilentlyContinue; [WPS]::Set($w); Write-Output 'Wallpaper applied'

steps.label: BitLocker OFF
steps.desc: Disable BitLocker encryption on C: drive

steps.label: Firewall OFF
steps.desc: Disable Windows Firewall on all profiles

steps.label: Tamper Protection OFF
steps.desc: Disable Defender Tamper Protection via registry

steps.label: Install 7-Zip
steps.cmd: $i=Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*' -EA SilentlyContinue|?{$_.DisplayName -like '*7-Zip*'}; if(-not $i){$d='C:\M-auto\Temp'; md $d -Force -EA SilentlyContinue|Out-Null; $t="$d\7z.exe"; irm 'https://www.7-zip.org/a/7z2409-x64.exe' -OutFile $t; Start-Process $t '/S' -Wait; del $t -Force; Write-Output 'OK'}else{Write-Output 'ALREADY INSTALLED'}

steps.label: Create Restore Point
steps.cmd: Enable-ComputerRestore -Drive 'C:\' -EA SilentlyContinue; Checkpoint-Computer -Description 'M-Auto Backup' -RestorePointType MODIFY_SETTINGS -EA Stop

categories.label: Mercedes-Benz
categories.desc: Instalar ficheiros Mercedes descarregados de C:\M-auto\Temp

steps.label: Criar Estrutura de Pastas
steps.desc: Cria todas as pastas necessarias para Mercedes-Benz em C:\M-auto\Daimler
steps.cmd: $dirs=@('C:\M-auto\Temp','C:\M-auto\Daimler\SDMEDIA','C:\M-auto\Daimler\DATABASES','C:\M-auto\Daimler\Vin decoder\MB_VIN v3.0.3 D-PDU','C:\M-auto\Daimler\Vin decoder\MB_VIN v3.0.3 J2534','C:\M-auto\Daimler\Coding tutorials full'); foreach($d in $dirs){New-Item $d -ItemType Directory -Force -EA SilentlyContinue|Out-Null; Write-Output "OK: $d"}

steps.label: Instalar SDMEDIA
steps.desc: Extrai SDMEDIA.zip de Temp para C:\M-auto\Daimler\SDMEDIA
steps.cmd: $src='C:\M-auto\Temp\SDMEDIA.zip'; $dst='C:\M-auto\Daimler\SDMEDIA'; if(!(Test-Path $src)){Write-Output 'ERRO: SDMEDIA.zip nao encontrado em Temp'; exit 1}; New-Item $dst -ItemType Directory -Force -EA SilentlyContinue|Out-Null; & 'C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7z.exe' x $src -o"$dst" -y | Out-Null; Write-Output "OK: extraido para $dst"

steps.label: Instalar Databases
steps.desc: Extrai Databases.7z de Temp para C:\M-auto\Daimler\DATABASES
steps.cmd: $src='C:\M-auto\Temp\Databases.7z'; $dst='C:\M-auto\Daimler\DATABASES'; if(!(Test-Path $src)){Write-Output 'ERRO: Databases.7z nao encontrado em Temp'; exit 1}; New-Item $dst -ItemType Directory -Force -EA SilentlyContinue|Out-Null; & 'C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7z.exe' x $src -o"$dst" -y | Out-Null; Write-Output "OK: extraido para $dst"

steps.label: Instalar Tutorial Beta
steps.desc: Copia tutorial beta.exe de Temp para C:\M-auto\Daimler
steps.cmd: $src='C:\M-auto\Temp\tutorial beta.exe'; $dst='C:\M-auto\Daimler\tutorial beta.exe'; if(!(Test-Path $src)){Write-Output 'ERRO: tutorial beta.exe nao encontrado em Temp'; exit 1}; Copy-Item $src $dst -Force; Write-Output "OK: copiado para $dst"

steps.label: Instalar VIN Decoder D-PDU
steps.desc: Extrai MB_VIN D-PDU de Temp para C:\M-auto\Daimler\Vin decoder\MB_VIN v3.0.3 D-PDU
steps.cmd: $f=Get-ChildItem 'C:\M-auto\Temp' -Filter '*D-PDU*' -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if(!$f){Write-Output 'ERRO: ficheiro VIN D-PDU nao encontrado em Temp'; exit 1}; $dst='C:\M-auto\Daimler\Vin decoder\MB_VIN v3.0.3 D-PDU'; New-Item $dst -ItemType Directory -Force -EA SilentlyContinue|Out-Null; & 'C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7z.exe' x $f.FullName -o"$dst" -y | Out-Null; Write-Output "OK: extraido para $dst"

steps.label: Instalar VIN Decoder J2534
steps.desc: Extrai MB_VIN J2534 de Temp para C:\M-auto\Daimler\Vin decoder\MB_VIN v3.0.3 J2534
steps.cmd: $f=Get-ChildItem 'C:\M-auto\Temp' -Filter '*J2534*' -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if(!$f){Write-Output 'ERRO: ficheiro VIN J2534 nao encontrado em Temp'; exit 1}; $dst='C:\M-auto\Daimler\Vin decoder\MB_VIN v3.0.3 J2534'; New-Item $dst -ItemType Directory -Force -EA SilentlyContinue|Out-Null; & 'C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7z.exe' x $f.FullName -o"$dst" -y | Out-Null; Write-Output "OK: extraido para $dst"

steps.label: Instalar Coding Tutorials
steps.desc: Extrai/copia Coding tutorials full de Temp para C:\M-auto\Daimler\Coding tutorials full
steps.cmd: $dst='C:\M-auto\Daimler\Coding tutorials full'; New-Item $dst -ItemType Directory -Force -EA SilentlyContinue|Out-Null; $f=Get-ChildItem 'C:\M-auto\Temp' -Filter '*Coding*' -EA SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if(!$f){Write-Output 'ERRO: ficheiro Coding Tutorials nao encontrado em Temp'; exit 1}; if($f.Extension -match '7z|zip|rar'){& 'C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7z.exe' x $f.FullName -o"$dst" -y | Out-Null}else{Copy-Item $f.FullName $dst -Force}; Write-Output "OK: instalado em $dst"
